acquisition_method.evidence: The Q Exactive HF was operated in data-independent mode (DIA) with a scan range of 350-1650 m/z, orbitrap resolution 240000 FWHM, 3e6 AGC target and maximum injection time (max. IT) 20 ms for MS1 scan.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: For MS analysis, cell pellets were lysed in 100 μl of lysis buffer containing 6 M guanidine hydrochloride (GuHCl), 5 mM tris-(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and 10 mM chloroacetamide, boiled for 10 min at 99 °C and sonicated at 4°C using a BioRuptor (Diagenode, Seraing) with high intensity for 10 cycles (30 sec ON / 30 sec OFF).
